title: (kudelskisecurity.com) Critical Zero-Day Vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway Enable Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution In

CVE-2026-88771.evidence: Citrix confirmed exploits observed on unmitigated deployments and CISA confirmed active global exploitation; CERT-EU reports in-the-wild use deploying a persistent PHP web shell.

CVE-2026-88772.evidence: Citrix and CISA confirmed CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 both exploited on unmitigated deployments per the Kudelski advisory of bulletin CTX697096.
